The short 8 kHz mono signed 16-bit speech fixture is from
[py-webrtcvad/test-audio.raw](https://github.com/wiseman/py-webrtcvad/blob/master/test-audio.raw),
Git blob `c8d903ebd53312fed6780430f7963b74034d95d8`.
See WebRTC-test-LICENSE.txt for its upstream license notices.
Tests convert it to 16 kHz in memory. The fixture is test-only and excluded
from installed binary release packages.
